sub_graphs.title: Cancun Environment Instructions: Account State Access
sub_graphs.description: Models how environment opcodes read account state including balance queries and code access patterns

nodes.label: EVM Executing Contract Code
nodes.description: EVM is in the process of executing bytecode and encounters an environment opcode

nodes.label: Check Accessed Addresses Set
nodes.description: Check if target address is already in evm.accessed_addresses set to determine gas cost

nodes.label: Address Cold (Not Accessed)
nodes.description: Target address has not been accessed this transaction, requires cold access gas

nodes.label: Address Warm (Already Accessed)
nodes.description: Target address is already in accessed set, requires only warm access gas

nodes.label: Charge Cold Account Access Gas
nodes.description: Deduct GAS_COLD_ACCOUNT_ACCESS from available gas and add address to accessed set

nodes.label: Charge Warm Access Gas
nodes.description: Deduct GAS_WARM_ACCESS from available gas for cached address lookup

nodes.label: Query Account Balance from State
nodes.description: Read balance field from account state trie for BALANCE opcode

nodes.label: Query External Code Size
nodes.description: Read code length from account for EXTCODESIZE opcode

nodes.label: Query External Code Hash
nodes.description: Compute keccak256 hash of account code for EXTCODEHASH opcode

nodes.label: Push Result to Stack
nodes.description: Push queried value onto EVM stack as U256

nodes.label: Query Result on Stack
nodes.description: EVM stack now contains the queried account state value

edges.label: Environment opcode needs external account data
BALANCE opcode execution after cold gas
BALANCE opcode execution after warm gas

sub_graphs.title: Cancun Environment Instructions: Call Data Access and Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models how CALLDATALOAD, CALLDATASIZE, CALLDATACOPY access transaction input data with bounds handling

nodes.label: Call Data Available in Message
nodes.description: Transaction or internal call has input data stored in evm.message.data

nodes.label: Pop Data Offset from Stack
nodes.description: Pop offset value from stack for CALLDATALOAD indicating where to read

nodes.label: Buffer Read from Call Data
nodes.description: Read bytes from message.data using buffer_read with zero-padding for out-of-bounds

nodes.label: Push 32-byte Call Data Value
nodes.description: Push 32-byte word from call data to stack as U256

nodes.label: Call Data Value on Stack
nodes.description: Requested call data bytes now available on stack

nodes.label: Get Call Data Size
nodes.description: Compute length of evm.message.data for CALLDATASIZE

nodes.label: Copy Call Data to Memory
nodes.description: Copy slice of call data to EVM memory with zero-padding using memory_write

nodes.label: Calculate Memory Expansion Gas
nodes.description: Compute additional gas cost for memory expansion via calculate_gas_extend_memory

nodes.label: EVM Memory Expanded
nodes.description: EVM memory has been expanded to accommodate copied data

external_entities.name: Transaction Sender
external_entities.description: External entity that provided the call data in the original transaction

sub_graphs.title: Cancun Environment Instructions: Return Data Access with Bounds Checking
sub_graphs.description: Models RETURNDATASIZE and RETURNDATACOPY with the critical out-of-bounds read validation

nodes.label: Return Data Available from Previous Call
nodes.description: EVM has return data from a previous CALL/DELEGATECALL/STATICCALL stored in evm.return_data

nodes.label: Get Return Data Size
nodes.description: Compute length of evm.return_data for RETURNDATASIZE opcode

nodes.label: Pop Copy Parameters from Stack
nodes.description: Pop dest_offset, offset, and size from stack for RETURNDATACOPY

nodes.label: Validate Return Data Bounds
nodes.description: Check if offset + size > len(return_data) to prevent out-of-bounds read

nodes.label: Bounds Check Passed
nodes.description: Requested return data range is within valid bounds

nodes.label: Bounds Check Failed - OutOfBoundsRead
nodes.description: Requested range exceeds return data length, operation must revert

nodes.label: Raise OutOfBoundsRead Exception
nodes.description: Raise OutOfBoundsRead exception causing execution to revert

nodes.label: Copy Return Data to Memory
nodes.description: Copy validated slice of return data to EVM memory

nodes.label: Execution Reverted
nodes.description: EVM execution has reverted due to invalid return data access

nodes.label: Return Data Copied to Memory
nodes.description: Valid return data slice now available in EVM memory

sub_graphs.title: Cancun Environment Instructions: Blob Data Access
sub_graphs.description: Models BLOBHASH and BLOBBASEFEE opcodes for EIP-4844 blob transaction support

nodes.label: Blob Transaction Context Active
nodes.description: EVM is executing within a type-3 blob transaction with versioned hashes available

nodes.label: Pop Blob Index from Stack
nodes.description: Pop index value from stack to select which blob hash to retrieve

nodes.label: Charge BLOBHASH Gas
nodes.description: Deduct GAS_BLOBHASH_OPCODE from available gas

nodes.label: Lookup Versioned Blob Hash
nodes.description: Retrieve versioned hash at specified index from blob_versioned_hashes list

nodes.label: Valid Blob Index
nodes.description: Index is within bounds of blob_versioned_hashes array

nodes.label: Invalid Blob Index - Returns Zero
nodes.description: Index exceeds available blobs, returns zero hash

nodes.label: Push Blob Hash to Stack
nodes.description: Push 32-byte versioned hash or zero to stack

nodes.label: Get Blob Base Fee from Block
nodes.description: Retrieve blob base fee calculated from excess_blob_gas in block header

nodes.label: Blob Data on Stack
nodes.description: Blob hash or blob base fee now available on stack

edges.label: Blob base fee pushed to stack

external_entities.name: Blob Transaction Submitter
external_entities.description: External entity that submitted type-3 transaction with blob versioned hashes

ambiguities.text: EXTCODEHASH returns zero for empty accounts but the exact definition of 'empty account' is not stated in this module
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume empty account means account with no code, zero balance, and zero nonce per EIP-161. This definition should be verified against the account state module.

ambiguities.text: The exact numeric values for GAS_COLD_ACCOUNT_ACCESS and GAS_WARM_ACCESS are referenced but not defined in this module
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard EIP-2929 values: GAS_COLD_ACCOUNT_ACCESS=2600, GAS_WARM_ACCESS=100. Values should be verified from gas constants module.

implicit_assumptions.description: The accessed_addresses set is correctly initialized at transaction start with pre-warmed addresses
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect gas charging - could charge cold access for addresses that should be warm, or vice versa, leading to gas griefing or undercharging

implicit_assumptions.description: buffer_read function correctly zero-pads when reading beyond buffer bounds
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: CALLDATALOAD could return garbage data instead of zero-padded values for out-of-bounds reads, potentially causing contract logic errors

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot manipulate the evm.return_data buffer except through legitimate CALL operations
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If return_data could be corrupted, RETURNDATACOPY could leak unintended data or cause unexpected behavior
